title: Tandoori Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish featuring marinated lamb, grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground lamb, tandoori masala, lemon juice, greek yogurt, garlic, and salt. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Brush the grates with ghee or oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
